canonical_title: Mission closure records cite exact CI run numbers and test counts, not narrative claims alone
summary: SB-OPS-CI-ARCHITECTURE-1.0's acceptance and post-merge closure records cite exact workflow run numbers/IDs for each verification pass, and exact test/file counts wherever those counts are actually recorded, rather than asserting success only in general terms.

claims.text: Mission Control recorded exact run numbers and run IDs for Markdown Quality Gate, Application Build Assurance, and Full Assurance on both the accepted implementation head and a later pre-review communication head. Exact Fast Test file/test counts (8/8 files, 61/61 tests) are recorded only for the implementation head; exact Full Assurance file/test counts (20/20 files, 108/108 tests) are recorded for both heads.

evidence.locator: ## 3. Verified evidence: exact run numbers/IDs for both heads (implementation head 74455d5... and pre-review head 6a3ea8f...); exact Fast Test counts (8/8 files, 61/61 tests) recorded only for the implementation head; exact Full Assurance counts (20/20 files, 108/108 tests) recorded for both heads

claims.text: Post-merge closure recorded exact run numbers/IDs for Application Build Assurance, Markdown Quality Gate, and Full Assurance against the actual merge commit, plus exact Full Assurance results (20/20 files, 108/108 tests, 0 failures).

evidence.locator: ## Post-merge assurance: run numbers/IDs for all three workflows, and the '20/20 test files, 108/108 tests, 0 failures' breakdown
## Chronology, last two bullets: same three run numbers/IDs and the 20/20 files, 108/108 tests result, restated in the archive manifest

conditions: Requires the CI platform to expose stable, citable run numbers/IDs that remain resolvable after the fact.
anti_patterns: Closing a mission with only a general 'CI passed' statement, without recording which exact run, on which exact commit, verified which exact test count -- an unfalsifiable and unauditable closure claim.
